newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: YACHTING-Global Challenge leader sails into Wellington.
newsitem.headline: YACHTING-Global Challenge leader sails into Wellington.

text.p: The leading yacht in the BT Global Challenge race sailed into Wellington harbour on Monday to be greeted by a cannon, bagpipes and hundreds of spectators.
Group 4 was the first of the 14 yachts to reach its destination in the second leg of the epic race, after 40 days' sailing from Rio de Janeiro.
More than 500 onlookers greeted the yacht, which made agonisingly slow progress in the final stages because of abnormally calm conditions.

Organisers said celebrations would proceed over the next five days despite an overnight tragedy in Wellington harbour, where four people died and one was missing after a fishing boat and a container ship collided.
The race is billed as the world's toughest because vessels are sailing the "wrong way" around the globe, against prevailing winds and currents.
